style: STYLE: a heraldry-inspired emblem drawn as a flat black-and-white icon, for a grim dark-fantasy medieval rulebook. Black ink pen on pure white paper ONLY: every mark is either solid black or untouched white. Bold, clean, confident outlines of even weight and a few solid black shapes. ABSOLUTELY NO grey, no shading, no hatching, no cross-hatching, no stippling, no texture, no gradients, no fine or dense lines, no engraving effect, no 3D, no highlights, no drop shadow. It is an icon: simple, bold, instantly readable when printed only a quarter of an inch tall, like a woodcut printer's device or a stamp. Grim and medieval in spirit: the shield edge is slightly chipped and battle-worn, shown only by its silhouette, never by texture. Centred on a plain white background with a wide empty margin on every side. No text, letters, numbers, mottoes or watermarks. No mantling, crest, helm above the shield, supporters, crown, frame, scroll or scenery.
series: SERIES: one of fifteen chapter icons that must read as a matched set. Every icon is the same upright heater shield (flat top, straight sides curving to a point), seen straight on, outlined by the same bold black double rim (a thick outer line, a thin white gap, a thin inner line), with the same proportions. The field inside is plain white. In the centre is ONE simple charge drawn as a solid black silhouette with a few white interior lines only where needed to read it, filling about two thirds of the shield. Keep the charge as simple as a road sign or a game icon: the fewest shapes that make it recognisable, no small details.

items.subject: The emblem of HERALDRY SKIRMISH: THE DYING LANDS. A heater shield, broken: one jagged crack runs from the top edge down into the shield, and a chunk has broken off the upper right corner, with two small fragments falling away beside it. On the shield, a single castle charge as a solid black silhouette: a gatehouse of three crenellated towers, the middle one tallest, with a white arched gate and a few white arrow-slit windows. The field is plain white. Bold double black rim, chipped. The arms of a fallen realm: noble, ancient and ruined.
Charge: an orb with a cross on top (a globus cruciger), solid black, with one white band around its middle and one white band rising to the cross.
Charge: a single six-sided die in three-quarter view, white faces with a black outline, its pips solid black: one, two and three pips on the visible faces.
Charge: an hourglass, solid black frame top and bottom, the glass as a white outline, a solid black heap of sand in the lower bulb and a thin falling stream.
Charge: a tall riding boot in profile as a solid black silhouette, with a large star-shaped spur at the heel.
Charge: two broad longswords crossed in an X, points upward, as bold solid black silhouettes with wide blades and clear cross-guards and pommels.
Charge: a swallow-tailed war banner flying from a lance, as a solid black silhouette, with a small white cross on the banner.
Charge: a medieval great helm seen from the front, solid black, with a white horizontal eye slit and a white vertical line down the middle.
Charge: a tall three-tongued flame rising from a footed brazier bowl, both as solid black silhouettes.
Charge: a monster's head in profile facing left, a horned wyvern with open fanged jaws, as a solid black silhouette with a white eye, its neck ending in a jagged torn edge.
Charge: a ruined round stone archway, as a solid black silhouette, one side of the arch broken off, a couple of fallen blocks at its foot.
Charge: a peaked medieval war tent (pavilion) as a solid black silhouette, with a white open door flap and a small pennant on its pole.
Charge: a large old key, upright, bow at the top with a white four-lobed opening, as a solid black silhouette.
Charge: a hanging lantern with a ring at the top and a pointed cap, solid black frame with white panes and a small solid black flame inside.
Charge: an open book seen from above as a solid black silhouette, its two pages white with three short black lines on each, a ribbon bookmark hanging below.
Charge: a quill feather set diagonally, dipped into a small round ink pot below it, both as solid black silhouettes.
